description:
Are you passionate about standardizing data platforms and automating data engineering to drive analytics and reporting? Do you excel in dynamic, fast-paced environments and find joy in converting data into actionable insights? Are you adept at implementing data governance practices and defining data access and quality standards? If you thrive in innovation and can deliver scalable Data Engineering Solutions, then the Worldwide Operations Finance Standardization & Automation (SnA) team has an exciting opportunity for you! We are seeking a customer-centric Senior Data Engineer to establish a reliable and accessible data platform, ensuring Operations Finance customers have complete trust in the data, technology, and tools to make data-driven business decisions.

As a Senior Data Engineer in WW S&A, you will be working in one of the world's largest and most complex data ecosystems. You will design, build, and own scalable data domains that serve as the foundational layer for the business. In this role, you will architect and implement robust, well-governed data domain models that integrate multi-heterogeneous data sources, enabling seamless consumption across a wide spectrum of use cases - including real-time and batch analytics, interactive dashboards and reporting, machine learning and predictive modeling, operational automation, API-driven data services, self-service exploration, and ad-hoc data requests. As a Sr. DE, you will define domain boundaries, establish data contracts, and curate high-quality, discoverable datasets that empower cross-functional teams to derive insights quickly and reliably, while ensuring data is aggregated, retrieved, and served in a fast, secure, and scalable manner across all consumption patterns. You should have excellent business and communication skills to be able to work with business owners, Product teams and Tech leaders to gather infrastructure requirements, design data infrastructure, build up data pipelines and data-sets to meet business needs. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and operating a data service platform using Python, Airflow, and SQL to build the various ETL, analytics, and data quality components. You’ll automate deployments using AWS CodeDeploy, AWS CodePipeline, AWS Cloud Development Kit (CDK), and AWS Cloud Formation. You will work with AWS services like Redshift, Glue, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, and more.

description:
The AWS Analytics Engineering (AAE) organization is the analytics backbone of AWS. We build and operate the data platform that powers business decisions across more than 250 AWS services. Every insight surfaced to AWS product leadership, from service adoption trends to revenue drivers, flows through systems our team designs, builds, and maintains.

We operate at massive scale, processing petabytes of data daily through thousands of jobs spanning transformations, reporting queries, ingestions, and infrastructure management scripts. Our engineers work directly with source systems to procure data, convert it into structured formats, build large-scale processing pipelines, design analytical data models, and maintain infrastructure with the highest security and compliance standards.

We are seeking a Data Engineer II to join our team. You will own data pipelines and analytical models within one or more data domains, improve the quality and accessibility of high-value datasets, and contribute to architectural improvements that support how AWS leaders make decisions. You will partner with service teams across AWS to clarify data requirements, implement data contracts and ingestion flows, and deliver scalable analytical datasets for customers across the organization.

The ideal candidate is an experienced data engineer who independently delivers reliable solutions to difficult data problems and seeks direction when broader architectural decisions require it. You have strong SQL, ETL, data modeling, and programming skills, with experience using cloud-based data services such as AWS EMR, Glue, Redshift, and Lambda. Experience applying AI/ML technologies, including LLMs and agentic workflows, to data engineering use cases is valuable. You are comfortable working through loosely defined requirements, collaborating with technical and business partners, and building secure, maintainable data solutions at AWS scale.



Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, and optimize logical data models and data pipelines for difficult datasets in the team's area. Translate loosely defined business requirements into secure, testable, maintainable, and efficient data solutions.
- Own the quality and operational health of assigned datasets and pipelines. Establish monitoring, alarming, runbooks, data validation, and SLA tracking, and participate in the team's on-call rotation.
- Contribute to data architecture and design decisions for the solutions you own. Apply established patterns and make sound trade-offs among delivery speed, scalability, maintainability, security, and cost.
- Build and operate infrastructure for assigned data solutions using automation and team standards. Anticipate access and processing needs, troubleshoot failures, and remove recurring operational bottlenecks.
- Partner with AWS service teams and analytics customers to clarify requirements, define data contracts, resolve data quality issues, and improve self-service access to trusted datasets.
- Own projects or substantial project components from design through launch and ongoing operations. Identify dependencies and risks, coordinate with peers and partner teams, and escalate when broader alignment or architectural guidance is needed.
- Apply data engineering best practices for code quality, testing, documentation, naming, dependency management, data certification, security, and auditability.
- Participate in code reviews and design discussions, provide constructive technical feedback, share knowledge, and begin mentoring less-experienced engineers.
- Identify limitations in existing data solutions and implement or propose improvements. Contribute to reusable patterns and larger architectural initiatives led by senior engineers.
- Explore and apply AI/ML technologies, including LLMs and agentic workflows, to improve data discovery, pipeline development, operational support, and analytics productivity.

description:
The newest business group in AWS, Applied AI Solutions are built by AWS and AWS Partners to deliver applied AI solutions that leverage Amazon’s operational expertise and that businesses love and trust for their day-to-day success. Our ambition is to become a partner which companies can rely on to run their business every day, putting AI to work delivering better customer experience, operational excellence and speed.

We are seeking a Data Engineer to design, build and maintain our next-generation data infrastructure - one that seamlessly serves both human analysts and AI systems. This role sits at the intersection of traditional enterprise data warehousing and innovative AI technologies, requiring someone who can bridge these worlds to create a unified, future-proof data ecosystem.

As a key member of our data team, you'll collaborate across organizational boundaries with data scientists, engineers, analytics teams, and business stakeholders to develop innovative and scalable solutions that push the boundaries of what's possible with our data assets.

You'll be responsible for ensuring our datasets maintain the highest levels of accuracy, consistency, and observability - implementing comprehensive monitoring, lineage tracking, and self-healing mechanisms that maintain data quality at scale. In this role, you'll champion a forward-thinking approach to data infrastructure that anticipates the evolving needs of AI systems while maintaining the reliability and performance that business operations demand. You'll help shape our technical roadmap for data systems that will serve as the foundation for our organization's AI transformation journey.

- Experience building and maintaining datasets and feature pipelines for ML/GenAI training, fine-tuning, and inference (Amazon SageMaker, Bedrock, or equivalent).
- Experience implementing data quality, lineage, and observability that AI workloads depend on including validation, freshness/anomaly monitoring, and alerting at scale.
- 5+ years of Python (or Scala/Java) and advanced SQL, including performance tuning at scale.
- Experience with batch and streaming ETL/ELT on AWS (Glue, EMR/Spark, S3, Athena) and a production cloud data warehouse (Amazon Redshift or equivalent).
- Experience designing data models and schemas for analytical, operational, and AI/retrieval workloads.
- Experience with workflow orchestration (Step Functions, Airflow, or Glue Workflows).
